title: Understanding Percentages
keyIdea: Per cent means 'out of 100', and the sign is %. So 35% means 35 out of every 100. You can write it as the fraction 35/100 or as the decimal 0.35, because both count hundredths. The whole thing is 100%, half is 50% and a quarter is 25%. Watch the decimal places: 0.07 is 7%, but 0.7 is 70%.
familyTip: Hunt for the % sign together: on a phone battery, a juice carton or a sale sign. Each time, ask: out of 100, how many is that? Then ask what is left. A battery on 30% has 70% used up.

visual.caption: Which per cent is each amount? Drag each card, or tap it and then tap a box.

lab.caption: Flagship lab: shade a hundred square to make 40%, shade decimals, make half and a quarter, find the part left and sort 40% from 4%.

kid: Cent means hundred, as in a century of 100 years. So per cent means per hundred. The sign % is a quick way to write it. 40% means 40 out of every 100.
Think of a big square cut into 100 small squares. Shade 40 of them and you have shaded 40%. As a fraction that is 40/100. As a decimal it is 0.40, or 0.4, which says 40 hundredths.
Be careful with decimals. In 0.07 the 7 is in the hundredths place, so it is only 7 squares: 7%. In 0.7 the 7 is in the tenths place, so it is 7 whole rows: 70%.
The whole square is 100%. Half of it is 50%, a quarter is 25% and a tenth is 10%. If 35% is shaded, the rest is 65%, because the two parts make 100%.
adult: Year 5 in the National Curriculum in England: recognise the per cent symbol, understand that per cent relates to 'number of parts per hundred', and write percentages as a fraction with denominator 100 and as a decimal. It builds directly on hundredths from Year 4, and Year 6 then uses it to find percentages of amounts. CCSS introduces percent as a rate per 100 in Grade 6 (6.RP.A.3c).

The 10 × 10 hundred square is the model the lab uses. Each small square is 1/100 = 0.01 = 1%, and each row is 1/10 = 0.1 = 10%. This lets children see that 0.4, 0.40, 40/100 and 40% are one amount, and that 100% is the whole, not '100 things'.

Common mistakes: reading 0.07 as 70% or 0.7 as 7% (a place-value slip); writing 35% as 3.5; thinking 60% = 60/10; saying a quarter is 4% because a quarter has a 4 in it; comparing 0.5 and 45% by their digits; and giving the shaded percentage when the unshaded part was asked. Ask your child to say the amount as 'hundredths' to check.

practice.explain: 30% is 30 out of every 100, so it is 30/100 or 0.30.

practice.prompt: {k} of the 100 squares in a hundred square are shaded. What per cent is shaded? (Type the number.)
practice.hint: Each small square is 1 out of 100, which is 1%.

practice.prompt: {k}% of a hundred square is shaded. What per cent is NOT shaded? (Type the number.)
practice.hint: The whole square is 100%. Take away the shaded part.

practice.prompt: Which decimal is the same as 7%?
practice.hint: 7% is 7 hundredths. Which place holds hundredths?
practice.explain: 7% = 7/100 = 0.07. The 7 sits in the hundredths place. 0.7 would be 70%.

practice.prompt: Which of these is the same as 25%?
practice.hint: Split 100 into 4 equal parts. How big is each part?

pool.hint: 35% is 35 hundredths. Write it with two decimal places.
pool.explain: 35% = 35/100 = 0.35. The 3 is 3 tenths and the 5 is 5 hundredths.

pool.hint: Per cent always means out of 100.

pool.prompt: Mia gets 100% in a spelling test. What does that mean?
choices: She got nearly all the marks
pool.hint: 100 out of every 100 is the whole thing.
pool.explain: 100% means all of it, the whole test, however many marks it had.

pool.prompt: A phone battery shows {b}%. What per cent of the battery has been used? (Type the number.)
pool.hint: A full battery is 100%. Used plus left makes the whole.
pool.explain: 100% − {b}% = {=100-b}% used. The two parts make the whole.

pool.prompt: A hundred square has {r} whole rows shaded. What per cent is shaded? (Type the number.)
pool.hint: One row has 10 squares, so one row is 10%.
pool.explain: {r} rows × 10 squares = {=10*r} squares, so {=10*r}% is shaded.

pool.prompt: Half of a hundred square is shaded. Which is NOT the same amount?
pool.hint: Half of 100 squares is how many squares?
pool.explain: Half of 100 is 50, so half = 50/100 = 0.5 = 50%. 5% is only 5 squares.
